strings.MapStory01:
I have followed the treasure map deep into the jungle. 
Now, well hidden in the thicket the ancient temple lies before me.
strings.MapStory02:
It feels good to be prepared! I was right to bring my hot-air balloon. 
I never leave home without it!
strings.MapStory03:
Whoops, it's really dark in here, but a real adventurer like me 
is not scared of the dark... At all!
strings.MapStory04:
Somehow, I can't shake the feeling that I'm being watched... 
But by whom or what? Except for me and all these mosters there's nobody around... 
Then again...
strings.MapStory05:
I can't help but wonder, how these monsters got here. 
Something is odd about that!
strings.MapStory06: Ok, monsters! Come on, let's see what you've got!
strings.MapStory07:
Slowly but surely I am advancing deeper and deeper into the temple, 
closer to my destination.
strings.MapStory08: I am getting the hang of this! Nothing can stop a true hero like me!!
strings.MapStory09:
There is quite some unusual stuff around here. 
I should have brought my camera....
strings.MapStory10:
Sigh, to look at all these beautiful gems is really touching. 
This is definitely worth the trouble!
strings.MapStory11:
And all these ancient coins! Seems that I don't have to worry 
about my retirement money anymore!
strings.MapStory12: Hmmm... I wonder what lies up ahead?
strings.MapStory13:
This turns out to be a real labyrinth. Maybe I should ask for directions? 
But then again, I never do.
strings.MapStory14:
There is nothing I love more than a real challenge! 
God forbid, I don't want this to get boring!
strings.MapStory15: This is the most fun I had since my last trip to the Shlimalaya!
strings.MapStory16: Nice! According to my map, I actually made more than half of the way.
strings.MapStory17: Adventurers trivia no. 592: Carrots are good for your eyes.
strings.MapStory18: Quite the buzz in here, for a supposedly abandoned and forgotten temple.
strings.MapStory19:
I sense, that I am getting closer to the jewel. 
I can almost see its glint...
strings.MapStory20:
I must not get my spirits too high! Prudence is the 
virtue of the true adventurer.
strings.MapStory21:
I must admit, without my map I would probably get lost in here. 
At least I think I am on the right track...
strings.MapStory22:
This is probably a little late to start, but I can't help wondering 
who sent this map to me... and why?
strings.MapStory23:
I have been down here for quite a while. 
This legendary jewel can't be far now.
strings.MapStory24:
Does this arcane jewel really exist? 
I just hope nobody played a trick on me!
strings.MapStory25: A-ha! I just heard snickering! Is there someone making fun of me?!
strings.MapStory26: Oh yeah! I will track down this jewel - piece of cake!
strings.MapStory27:
All these coins and gems are worth a fortune! 
But where the heck is that ominous jewel?!
strings.MapStory28:
Something is different. I am not quite sure, but I believe 
I can see a shimmering up ahead!
strings.MapStory29: The jewel must be somewhere around here!
strings.MapStory30: THIS is definitely NOT what I expected!
